 - 2 -  UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Delay condoned.
Application for impleadment is allowed.

Shri Vivek Narayan Sharma, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the original owner(s) and Shri Ranjit Kumar, learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the impleador(s)/person(s) in possession of part of the land in question have stated at the Bar that in view of the order passed by the High Court dated 13.08.1990 passed in CWP No.1252/1987 by which according to them the entire acquisition proceedings were quashed, Writ Petition (C) No.6351/2016 praying to declare that the acquisition is deemed to have lapsed under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short the 2013 Act) was not required at all to be preferred.
Therefore, the original writ petitioner(s) propose(s) to withdraw Writ Petition (C) No.6351/2016.

Without expressing anything on the order passed by the High Court dated 13.08.1990 in CWP No.1252/1987 and recording the statement made by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the original writ petitioner(s) as well as the Impleador(s) as above, we simply permit the original writ petitioner(s) to withdraw Writ Petition (C) No.6351/2016 filed before the High Court.

Consequently,
Writ Petition (C) No.6351/2016 before the High Court stands dismissed as withdrawn and the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court in Writ Petition (C) No.6351/2016 does not survive as the main writ petition itself is withdrawn.
Contd..
- 3 - With this, the present Special Leave Petition stands disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

(NEETU SACHDEVA) (NISHA TRIPATHI)
